environment.gpu: Apple M4 Pro, 16 cores; NVIDIA unavailable
environment.gpu_toolchain: CUDA-Oxide Linux lane and NVIDIA CUDA toolkit unavailable

decision.rationale: Historical P19-only blocker. The original Apple host had no NVIDIA device, CUDA driver/toolkit, nvcc, or CUDA-Oxide Linux execution lane, so CUDA JPEG decode profiling and A/B measurements could not run there. The later user-provided RTX lane supersedes this environmental blocker; the durable workplan now tracks active P19 CUDA profiling, which requires its own measured decision record. Metal P19 was completed separately in P19-metal-jpeg-decode-defusion.json. P18 CUDA encode is no longer part of this blocker and is documented by P18-cuda-jpeg-staged-encode.json.
